_comment: graph-forward review round 1 (Brainy 2958): GS1 and GR2. gs1: commands that run the Graph CLI's forward with a verb the SHELL assembles (brace expansion, variable, command substitution, ANSI-C quote, glob, an unclosed quote, a wrapper) -- the gates must read every one as a forward and refuse it at every level, because the strict forward reader cannot extract a letter from it. argv0 is what the CLI's argv[2] is when a real shell runs the command with a stub CLI (the test proves it in bash and, if present, zsh; null = not run, the shell refuses it or reads another verb). gr2: a plain send whose text mentions the forward command -- it stays a send, never a forward. The CLI is written `npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts`; the shell proof rewrites it to a stub path. ASCII only.

gs1.name: brace expansion of the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo{r,r}ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: brace list that starts with the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts {forward,send} --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: verb in a variable
gs1.cmd: V=forward; npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts $V --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: verb in a double-quoted variable
gs1.cmd: V=forward; npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts "$V" --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: verb in a braced variable
gs1.cmd: V=forward; npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts ${V} --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: verb from a command substitution
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts $(echo forward) --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: verb from a backtick substitution
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts `echo forward` --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: ANSI-C hex escape in the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts $'\x66orward' --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: ANSI-C octal escape in the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts $'\146orward' --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: glob star in the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo*ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: glob question mark in the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo?ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: glob bracket in the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo[r]ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: redirect before the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts >/dev/null forward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: unclosed double quote inside the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo"rward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: unclosed single quote inside the verb
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo'rward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment "Szia!" --orig-subject "Targy"

gs1.name: unparsable ANSI-C quote earlier, brace verb later
gs1.cmd: echo $'it\'s'; npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo{r,r}ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'Szia!' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: unparsable ANSI-C quote earlier, a decoy send word later, brace verb
gs1.cmd: echo $'it\'s'; npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo{r,r}ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment 'send' --orig-subject 'Targy'

gs1.name: a quoted send is not a literal verb (stricter than the shell, deliberate)
gs1.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts 'send' --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --subject 'Re' --body 'Szia!'

gs1.name: brace verb inside bash -c
gs1.cmd: bash -c "npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo{r,r}ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment Szia"

gs1.name: brace verb in a heredoc fed to bash
gs1.cmd:
bash <<'EOF'
npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts fo{r,r}ward --id AAMkAGFmZXN0MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ== --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --comment Szia
EOF

gr2.name: single-quoted body that quotes the forward command
gr2.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts send --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --subject 'Re' --body 'futtasd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts forward --id X'

gr2.name: double-quoted body that mentions the forward verb
gr2.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts send --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --subject 'Re' --body "a scripts/graph-mail.ts forward kesobb lesz"

gr2.name: subject that mentions the forward command
gr2.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts send --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --subject 'graph-mail forward teszt' --body 'Szia'

gr2.name: body that quotes a bash -c forward
gr2.cmd: npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts send --to kovacs@fireeng.hu --subject 'Re' --body 'bash -c "npx tsx scripts/graph-mail.ts forward --id X"'
